newsitem.title: UK: UK's PA News in newspaper pact as rival closes.
newsitem.headline: UK's PA News in newspaper pact as rival closes.

text.p: British news agency PA News said on Tuesday it agreed to supply news to papers served by UK News after the rival firm closes at the end of June.
PA said Northcliffe Newspapers Group Ltd and Newsquest Media Group Ltd had decided to close their jointly-owned agency, which serves 27 newspapers.
PA's new contracts with Northcliffe and Newsquest will be effective from July 1.
PA has existing contracts with Newsquest for five newspapers, and with Northcliffe for three.
The news agency also acquired the UK News title.
PA said it would offer new media, teletext and broadcast services to UK News non-newspaper customers. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
